mapper.insert: INSERT INTO forge_business_number (id, tenant_id, rule, period, value, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{rule}, #{period}, 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{actor}, #{actor}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, rule, period) WHERE NOT deleted DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE forge_business_number SET value = value + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{actor} WHERE rule = #{rule} AND period = #{period} AND NOT deleted
mapper.select: SELECT value FROM forge_business_number WHERE rule = #{rule} AND period = #{period} AND NOT deleted
mapper.update: UPDATE forge_business_number SET deleted = true, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = NULL WHERE NOT deleted
